fields.title: MERN Stack Developer
fields.description: We are looking for a skilled MERN Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with modern JavaScript frameworks and backend technologies, and be capable of building end-to-end solutions from concept to deployment.
fields.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.

Strong understanding of JavaScript and modern web development.

Experience building full-stack applications using React and Node.js.

Knowledge of REST APIs and database design.

Familiarity with Git and Agile development methodologies.
fields.responsibilities:
Develop and maintain full-stack web applications.

Build reusable frontend components using React.

Design RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.

Optimize application performance and scalability.

Collaborate with designers and backend engineers.

fields.title: Python Backend Developer
fields.description: We are seeking a Python Backend Developer to build and maintain scalable backend systems. The candidate will work closely with frontend developers and product teams to develop APIs and backend services.
fields.requirements:
Strong Python programming skills.

Understanding of databases and API development.

Experience working with backend frameworks.

Knowledge of software design principles.
fields.responsibilities:
Develop backend services and APIs.

Integrate databases and third-party services.

Write clean and maintainable code.

Perform testing and debugging.

Collaborate with development teams.

fields.title: Django Developer
fields.description: We are hiring a Django Developer to build robust web applications and backend systems. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Django, relational databases, and modern development practices.
fields.requirements:
Experience with Django and Python.

Knowledge of ORM concepts.

Experience with SQL databases.

Understanding of authentication and authorization systems.

Version control experience using Git.
fields.responsibilities:
Develop web applications using Django.

Build APIs and backend services.

Optimize database queries.

Implement authentication and security features.

Maintain and improve existing applications.

fields.title: Frontend Developer (React)
fields.description: We are looking for a Frontend Developer who is passionate about building responsive and user-friendly web applications. The candidate should have strong React and JavaScript skills.
fields.requirements:
Strong JavaScript fundamentals.

Experience with React.js.

Knowledge of modern CSS frameworks.

Understanding of responsive design principles.

Familiarity with REST API integration.
fields.responsibilities:
Develop responsive user interfaces.

Build reusable React components.

Integrate APIs with frontend applications.

Collaborate with designers and backend developers.

Improve performance and user experience.
